profile.headline: Software Engineer at Clarity
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in C#, Typescript, Java, Node.js, iOS, Linux, Microsoft Azure and AWS. Strong software engineering professional with a Master's of Science focused in Computer Science from North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this position I hold the following responsibilities:
Developing applications using Go, Python, and Javascript, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines
Deployed containerized applications using Docker, K8s, Helm, and ArgoCD
Monitored application health using Grafana
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Golang · Helm Charts · DevOps

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: In this position I developed a new framework for deploying our end-to-end tests to restricted environments using Azure Container Instances. This framework allows our tests to run continuously and integrates with our internal incident management system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: In this position I was responsible for updating our  Azure DveOps CI/CD pipelines to meet industry standards and implemented container based builds. I also worked on improving our credential scanning tool (Credscan) using C# and .NET.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
In this position I hold the following responsibilities:
Designing cloud architecture for application deployment with AWS.
Developing scalable backend solutions using Node.js.
Managing CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodeDeploy.
Designing and developing cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Requirements · Python · Project Teams · Git · React.js · Software Solutions · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · Test Automation · Software Implementation · System Requirements · Data Models · Business Strategy · Flutter

positions.title: Associate Cybersecurity Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this position I held the following responsibilities:
Contributed to Caldera, MITRE's open source Automated Adversary Emulation platform using Python, Go and Javascript
Architected a REST API that served Dark Web marketplace data that was acquired via our web scraping pipeline using Java, Spring Boot, Elasticsearch and Docker
Developed a geospatial algorithm testing framework that all for interop between Python and JVM based programming langurages
Migrated a signals intelligence UI from Vue to React and implemented realtime data visualization using Javascript, Three.js, and Docker
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Business Requirements · Python · C++ · Project Teams · Git · React.js · Software Solutions · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · Java · Test Automation · Software Implementation · System Requirements · Data Models · Business Strategy · Docker Products

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
In this position I hold the following responsibilities:
Designing and developing scalable backend applications using Node.js, Java, and Docker.
Developing front-end web applications using React, HTML, and CSS.
Creating and administrating SQL databases such as OracleDB, Postgres, and MySQL.
Developing unit tests using frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Chai, and JUnit.
Designing cloud architecture for application deployment using AWS, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry.
Implementing CI/CD pipelines using Git and Jenkins.
Managing project backlogs using Agile methodology and Redmine.
Preparing reports and briefing Senior Executives.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Requirements · Python · Project Teams · Git · React.js · Software Solutions · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · Java · Test Automation · Software Implementation · System Requirements · Data Models · Business Strategy

company.name: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
In this position my held the following responsibilities:
Developed and designed Android applications using Java and XML.
Ensured compliance with Android Security Guidlines.
Prepared learning modules to teach about secure Android development.
Delivered presentations to faculty and administration.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: During this internship I worked on developing various signal processing methods that will decrease battery consumption in different field devices.

positions.title: Americorps Member
positions.description: My job was to provide math tutoring to students in grades 5-12.
